translations.EN: I heard you. Watch yourself.
translations.TL: Narinig kita. Mag-ingat ka sa sarili mo.

translations.EN: Heard that tone. Mind your step.
translations.TL: Narinig ko ang tonong 'yan. Mag-ingat sa hakbang.

translations.EN: I heard the anger. Keep it in check.
translations.TL: Narinig ko ang galit. Kontrolin mo 'yan.

translations.EN: I hear you, but don't cross the line.
translations.TL: Narinig kita, pero huwag mong tawirin ang hangganan.

translations.EN: Message heard. Control yourself.
translations.TL: Narinig ang mensahe. Magpigil ka.

translations.EN: Heard that loud and clear. Back off.
translations.TL: Narinig nang malakas at malinaw. Umatras ka.

translations.EN: I heard you. Don't make a mistake you can't undo.
translations.TL: Narinig kita. Huwag kang gumawa ng pagkakamaling di mo mababawi.

translations.EN: I heard the threat. Tread lightly.
translations.TL: Narinig ko ang banta. Mag-ingat sa pagtapak.

translations.EN: Noted. Don't let your temper get you killed.
translations.TL: Tala ko na. Huwag mong hayaang mapatay ka ng galit mo.

translations.EN: I hear you. Watch your back.
translations.TL: Narinig kita. Bantayan mo ang likod mo.

translations.EN: Noted. Choose your next words carefully.
translations.TL: Tala ko na. Piliin mong mabuti ang susunod mong sasabihin.

translations.EN: Be very careful what comes out of your mouth next.
translations.TL: Maging maingat sa susunod na lalabas sa bibig mo.

translations.EN: You're walking on thin ice with that talk.
translations.TL: Nasa manipis kang yelo sa salitang 'yan.

translations.EN: Think twice before repeating that.
translations.TL: Mag-isip ka nang dalawang beses bago ulitin 'yan.

translations.EN: Choose your next move with extreme caution.
translations.TL: Piliin ang susunod mong hakbang nang buong pag-iingat.

translations.EN: You're testing boundaries that have teeth.
translations.TL: Sinusubukan mo ang mga hangganang may bangil.

translations.EN: Careful now. Words have consequences out here.
translations.TL: Mag-ingat ka. May kapalit ang salita dito.

translations.EN: Watch what you say next.
translations.TL: Bantayan mo ang susunod mong sasabihin.

translations.EN: One wrong word and this conversation ends badly.
translations.TL: Isang maling salita at magtatapos sa masama ang usapang ito.

translations.EN: Noted. Mind your tongue.
translations.TL: Tala ko na. Ingatan ang dila mo.
